name: Amaziah
summary: A son of Joash who reigned over Judah from Jerusalem. He defeated Edom but then bowed to Edom's gods, lost a war against Joash king of Israel, and was killed at Lachish.

key_moments.title: Sending the Hired Army Home
key_moments.description: Amaziah paid a hundred talents of silver to hire soldiers from Israel, but a man of God told him the LORD was not with them. He sent them home and went on to beat the men of Seir in the Valley of Salt.

key_moments.title: Bowing to Edom's Gods
key_moments.description: After his victory, Amaziah set up the gods of Seir as his own and burned incense to them. When a prophet asked why he sought gods that could not save their own people, Amaziah told him to stop.

key_moments.title: Defeated by Joash of Israel
key_moments.description: Amaziah challenged Joash king of Israel, who answered with a story of a thistle trampled by a wild beast. Amaziah would not listen, and Judah was beaten at Beth-shemesh and Jerusalem's wall broken down.

key_moments.title: Killed at Lachish
key_moments.description: After Amaziah turned away from the LORD, men in Jerusalem plotted against him. He escaped to Lachish, but they came after him and killed him there.
